body.message:
Good night, your man didn't help us. All the cockroaches are still around, and I killed them all, not this man. Even from the moment we entered the house, three hours later, the cockroaches were running around the apartment as if nothing had happened. Look at how many today, please take action and bring a normal person from Normal Company.
So that the cockroaches die because this man didn't do anything normal, let him come and kill these cockroaches properly.
